name: Myosin Heavy Chain 7関連ミオパチー

summary.text: A rare autosomal dominant distal myopathy characterized by preferential weakness of the great toe, ankle dorsiflexor, finger extensor and neck flexor. Progression is slow with variations in age of onset, severity, weakness, cardiac, and respiratory involvement.
summary.evidence: A rare autosomal dominant distal myopath

symptoms.text: preferential weakness of the great toe, ankle dorsiflexor, finger extensor and neck flexor
symptoms.evidence: preferential weakness of the great toe
